summary: Named for 2026: immersive rooms built from bars, lighting and backdrops more than centerpieces; statement bars with backbars, lit truss and big florals; creative non-row seating and unusual table shapes; greenery garland runners; LED lanterns along paths; grouped pillar candles; pendant lights; bud vases and colored glassware; draped greenery arches and wall florals.
